layout.area: u64 BE byte length of the entries, then the entries
layout.entry: u16 BE type, u32 BE length, then length bytes of value
layout.type: bit 15 (0x8000) critical, bits 0-14 the id; 0x0000 and 0x8000 invalid
layout.order: strictly ascending by the whole u16 type

cases.name: empty
cases.about: no entries: every area at release 1

cases.name: two_sorted
cases.about: 0x0002 then 0x8001: the order is by the whole u16, so a critical type sorts after every non-critical one

cases.name: at_cap
cases.about: one entry of exactly 4096 bytes (6 header + 4090 value)

cases.name: unsorted_critical_first
cases.about: 0x8001 then 0x0002 (the whole u16 is the order)

cases.name: bytes_left_over
cases.about: a whole entry, then 3 bytes: too few for an entry's 6-byte header

cases.name: over_cap
cases.about: one entry of 4097 bytes (6 header + 4091 value), otherwise well formed

area_cases.name: area_length_cut_short
area_cases.about: 3 bytes: too few for the u64 length

area_cases.name: area_length_past_end
area_cases.about: the u64 length says 10, a 9-byte entry follows

area_cases.name: area_length_over_cap
area_cases.about: the u64 length says 4097: refused before the input is read

area_cases.name: area_bytes_after
area_cases.about: the empty area, then one byte
